customManagers.description: Versions pinned in the Dockerfile ARGs and container/skills.sh, each under a `# renovate:` comment
Commit pins of untagged repositories in container/skills.sh, followed on their branch

packageRules.description: The base image matches the workstation's Ubuntu release: pin and refresh its digest, never move the release
DOCKER_CLI_VERSION must equal the host daemon's version (Dockerfile): upgrade the host first, then approve
prBodyNotes: Upgrade the workstation's Docker daemon to this version before deploying this change.

packageRules.description: NODE_MAINTENANCE_VERSION (Dockerfile) keeps the previous LTS until its end of life: patch and minor only
A skill is instructions an agent follows: read the diff before merging a new commit
prBodyNotes: Review the skill changes between the two commits before merging; agents follow them as instructions.
